client_host_repair.comparison_limit: Initial client infrastructure failures and extra model history/usage affect first-arm overhead; keep raw costs and disclose separately.

limitations: A single non-randomized pair is descriptive.
External model outputs need not match the original action counts.
High-level semantic success is not official native BDDL success.
Remote visual evidence requires review before declaring validated reproduction.
